notes.title: KotCT Update 1.2.2 Out Right Meow!
notes.notes:
We got a slew of new users from the Summer Sale and the Itch Bundle. And when you get an extra 10,000 people or so playing your game you are going to find some issues. We also updated the game to use the latest version of our favorite newly rebranded engine--Solar2D.  Many of you may see stability and speed improvements versus earlier builds.

Here's a quick list of (some of) the fixes in 1.2.2:

[list]
[*] Forge now has the ability to load the character sheet
[*] Fixed an issue where Mac users could get an error dying on level 105
[*] Fixed reward for "Bandaider" who is unlocked at level 38 or by Resurrecting 5 times
[*] Removed extra unneeded translation file
[*] Removed some unneeded libraries
[*] Updated to Solar2D build system
[*] Typo in monster manual
[*] Review plugin updated
[/list]

We will continue to tweak and balance and there are some feature requests we'd like to get to as well. 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Knights of the Card Table "I'm Feeling Lucky" Update 0.56
notes.notes:
So we wrangled a bunch of updates and fixes into a release that we're just pushing live. No testing, no non-sense. Just a new build that fixes sooooo much stuff.

[quote=author]Updated fireball+freeze tutorial
Fixed augment text, updated titles
More space for translated dialog
Missing icon fix
Default to villain image
Removed unneeded delays for card transitions
CallOut/DropOut fix for multiple misses
Fireball Mission Fix
Translation branch WIP
Module cleanup to save memory
Gold ramping (upwards) based on character level
Started work on character sheet/epic progress
Manually opening manual fix
[/quote]

People who weren't getting enough gold in later levels should get more, but maybe not enough. We'll keep an eye on that.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34104855/15852d077452579b0b8eff0be2dc50ab957b4eba.png[/img]

And that's right, our publisher is starting translation work, so hopefully we'll be supporting a bunch of new languages. Le Woot!
